n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

def make_C(n, mod):
    C = [[0] * (n+1) for _ in range(n+1)]
    C[0][0] = 1
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        C[i][0] = 1
        for j in range(1, i+1):
            C[i][j] = (C[i-1][j] + C[i-1][j-1]) % mod
    return C

def S1(tn, mod):
    return (tn * (tn + 1) // 2) % mod

C = make_C(n, mod)

g = [0] * (m+1)
sg = [0] * (m+1)

g[0] = 1
for i in range(1, m+1):
    for j in range(1, i+1):
        tmp = (g[j-1] * g[i-j] * C[i-1][j-1]) % mod
        g[i] = (g[i] + tmp * (i+1)) % mod
        sg[i] = (sg[i] + sg[j-1] * g[i-j] * C[i-1][j-1] * (i+1)) % mod
        sg[i] = (sg[i] + sg[i-j] * g[j-1] * C[i-1][j-1] * (i+1)) % mod
        sg[i] = (sg[i] + tmp * (S1(i-j, mod) + S1(j-1, mod))) % mod

f = [[0] * (m+1) for _ in range(n+1)]
sf = [[0] * (m+1) for _ in range(n+1)]

for i in range(n+1):
    f[i][0] = 1

for i in range(1, n+1):
    if i <= m:
        f[i][i] = g[i]
        sf[i][i] = sg[i]
    for j in range(1, min(i, m)+1):
        for t in range(i, 0, -1):
            if i - t > j:
                break
            tmp = (g[i - t] * C[j][i - t]) % mod
            f[i][j] = (f[i][j] + f[t-1][j - i + t] * tmp) % mod
            sf[i][j] = (sf[i][j] + sf[t-1][j - i + t] * tmp) % mod
            sf[i][j] = (sf[i][j] + f[t-1][j - i + t] * sg[i - t] * C[j][i - t]) % mod

print(sf[n][m])
